cases.testName: sync scroll update inside a discrete-event flush still lands (flushSync degradation)
cases.fullName: state wiring + scrolling sync scroll update inside a discrete-event flush still lands (flushSync degradation)

divergences.upstreamResult: Nested flushSync during a sync scroll notify re-enters React and applies the window update inside the nested flush.
divergences.octaneResult: Nested flushSync hits Octane's re-entrancy guard and degrades to a plain dispatch drained by the ambient flush; the window still updates once that flush settles.
divergences.rationale: Octane intentionally refuses nested flushSync; the adapter preserves upstream's flushSync-on-sync-scroll wiring and relies on the ambient flush to land the update.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumer-invisible for normal scroll/input paths; only programs that depend on nested flushSync completing before the outer flush continues can observe timing differences.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Keep relying on the settled window after the outer event/flush; do not assume nested flushSync mutates DOM before the outer flush returns.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains true nested flushSync or the adapter stops calling flushSync on sync scroll notifies.
